errors.text_span: Оста Y представлява дела на запазените при тях работни места също в проценти
errors.evidence: The description of the Y-axis is incomplete. The actual label is "Запазени работни места - кумулативна относителна честота (%)" (Retained jobs - cumulative relative frequency (%)). The description omits the key phrase "cumulative relative frequency".
The description fails to mention that the line is composed of many small, distinct circular markers. The prompt specifically asks to describe markers if they are present.
The line does not end at (100%, 100%). At X=100%, the Y value is visibly below the 100% mark, likely around 99%.
